tests.name: Foreground receipt
tests.steps: Kept the app visible and sent the valid payload to its current device token.
tests.expected: onMessage; delivery title and image update; fresh receipt metadata.
tests.observed: onMessage; receipt count 1 to 2; Out for delivery and van image; valid update diagnostic.
tests.note: The app already had one earlier receipt before this test. T1 is the fresh event at count 2.

tests.name: Background notification tap
tests.steps: Pressed Home, sent the same valid payload, opened the notification shade, and tapped the notification.
tests.expected: Delivered notification; onMessageOpenedApp after tap; delivery UI retained.
tests.observed: Notification delivered; tap ran onMessageOpenedApp; receipt count 3; delivery UI present; PID stayed 4248.
tests.note: The same app process (PID 4248) resumed. The new handler, count, and message ID establish a fresh event.

tests.name: Notification-triggered cold start
tests.steps: Dismissed the app from recents, verified its process ended and stopped=false, sent the same valid payload, then tapped its notification.
tests.expected: Notification-triggered launch; getInitialMessage; receipt count 1; delivery UI.
tests.observed: New process PID 5780; getInitialMessage; receipt count 1; Out for delivery and van image.
tests.right_label: Cold start from the notification tap
tests.note: Normal recents dismissal ended the app process. No Settings force-stop, launcher-icon start, or flutter run was used.

tests.name: Unsupported asset rejected
tests.steps: Kept the app foregrounded and changed only data.asset from promo to unknown.
tests.expected: onMessage; visible rejection; increased receipt metadata; previous title/image retained; no crash.
tests.observed: onMessage; count 1 to 2; Rejected: unsupported asset "unknown".; previous delivery title/image preserved; app stayed running.
tests.note: The title/image area is pixel-identical before and after (original screenshot region x=0..1344, y=160..1350).
